comment: No family is given to any of these ports: the matrix carries whatever is patched into it, audio or control voltage, and the panel says nothing either way. The trimpot at a given panel position is param (row + 4 times column), where the row is the input letter and the column is the output number (src/Eris.cpp:87-89); the maker's own configParam numbering is input plus 4 times output, which comes to the same thing. Param 17 is the aux gain menu setting and has no widget. The four numbered outputs are configured with the names 0 to 3 (src/Eris.cpp:22) while the panel prints 1 to 4. The vactrol's own source comments say the ramps are 6ms and 60ms, while the constants in the same function are 0.00125 and 0.0125 seconds (src/Vactrol.hpp:44-51); the constants are what runs.
